description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarView class from the SuiteCRM project. It utilizes PHPUnit framework to test methods related to view rendering, header/footer display, module title, metadata, and JavaScript output. The tests simulate view processing and ensure methods operate without exceptions, including content output verification.

classes.name: SugarViewTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the SugarView class methods in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testinit
methods.description: Tests the init() method of SugarView for successful execution without exceptions.

methods.name: testprocess
methods.description: Tests the process() method of SugarView ensuring it outputs content and doesn't throw exceptions.

methods.name: testdisplayErrors
methods.description: Checks that displayErrors() method operates without exceptions and returns empty errors array.

methods.name: testpreDisplay
methods.description: Tests the preDisplay() method for execution without exceptions.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Ensures display() method runs without exceptions.

methods.name: testdisplayHeader
methods.description: Verifies displayHeader() outputs content and completes without errors.

methods.name: testincludeClassicFile
methods.description: Tests includeClassicFile() with a valid filename to avoid require errors.

methods.name: testgetJavascriptValidation
methods.description: Validates that getJavascriptValidation() returns a non-empty string of JS code.

methods.name: testdisplayFooter
methods.description: Verifies displayFooter() outputs content and runs without exceptions.

methods.name: testrenderJavascript
methods.description: Checks renderJavascript() outputs JavaScript content without errors.

methods.name: testgetMenu
methods.description: Tests getMenu() returns an array for a valid module.

methods.name: testgetModuleTitle
methods.description: Verifies getModuleTitle() returns non-empty titles for various boolean parameters.

methods.name: testgetMetaDataFile
methods.description: Checks getMetaDataFile() returns null with missing attributes and a filepath with proper attributes.

methods.name: testgetBrowserTitle
methods.description: Ensures getBrowserTitle() returns a non-empty string.

methods.name: testgetBreadCrumbSymbol
methods.description: Verifies getBreadCrumbSymbol() returns a non-empty string.

methods.name: testcheckPostMaxSizeError
methods.description: Checks checkPostMaxSizeError() returns False when request parameters are absent.
